Hi Dana —

Thanks for the heads-up — totally understandable. We can absolutely accommodate a short extension without restarting the cadence. Two practical options from our side:

Option A — Timeboxed extension (preferred for consistency)
- +3 business days added to the current POC window.
- No change to pricing; same trial terms.
- You get an updated SOW addendum confirming the new end date.

Option B — Credit top-up (preferred if you need large batch runs)
- We can add a one-time token credit equivalent to ~48 compute-hours on the evaluation profile (rough parity with 3 days of heavy batch testing).
- Credit will be applied immediately; you can burn it within 30 days.

Operational notes: Option A requires a signed addendum (one-paragraph) and is the fastest to implement. Option B needs a one-line finance approval for the credit issuance.

I've attached a short addendum and an updated POC proposal (v3) with both options called out so your legal/ops team can review. Ben, Dev — tagging you to confirm finance/ops feasibility and to flag any infra limits if they run very large parallel batches.

If you want to discuss tradeoffs, happy to schedule a 20-minute call today or tomorrow.

Best,

- For Option A (timebox) we need a signed addendum that includes the revised end date and a line confirming no additional charges unless you exceed the originally agreed usage thresholds.
